expected_diagnosis: API token lacks permission for requested mutation.
recommended_next_checks: Check account role and documented token scopes.
resolution_guidance: Issue least-privilege authorized token/scope, not admin token by default.
verification: Reboot API works with appropriate owner authorization.
production_warning: Không áp dụng lệnh chỉnh sửa trên VPS khách hàng khi chưa có quyền, backup và kế hoạch rollback.
